remembrance: Observed-in-code. Generation and counters are stored per instance gobreaker.go:128 ("generation uint64"). Reset increments generation and clears all counters gobreaker.go:364 ("cb.generation++") gobreaker.go:365 ("cb.counts.clear()"). Admission counts once gobreaker.go:289 ("cb.counts.onRequest()") and reports do not release that admission count gobreaker.go:315 ("cb.counts.onSuccess()"). Old reports compare only generation gobreaker.go:299 ("if generation != before {"). Execute stack and retained Allow callback keep their captured values gobreaker.go:237 ("cb.afterRequest(generation, false)") gobreaker.go:272 ("tscb.cb.afterRequest(generation, success)"). No per-request history, queue, retention limit for caller-held closures, cancellation or shutdown entry point appears in the public surface gobreaker.go:262 ("// Allow checks if a new request can proceed. It returns a callback that should be used to").
lock_discipline: Observed-in-code. State, Counts, admission and completion acquire the same mutex gobreaker.go:207 ("cb.mutex.Lock()") gobreaker.go:217 ("cb.mutex.Lock()") gobreaker.go:277 ("cb.mutex.Lock()") gobreaker.go:294 ("cb.mutex.Lock()"). ReadyToTrip and OnStateChange are invoked from lock-held paths gobreaker.go:326 ("if cb.readyToTrip(cb.counts) {") gobreaker.go:359 ("cb.onStateChange(cb.name, prev, state)"). The Settings docs describe invocation gobreaker.go:95 ("// ReadyToTrip is called with a copy of Counts whenever a request fails in the closed state.") gobreaker.go:100 ("// OnStateChange is called whenever the state of the CircuitBreaker changes.") and give no reentry contract. Execute request and IsSuccessful run between the admission unlock and completion lock gobreaker.go:242 ("result, err := req()") gobreaker.go:243 ("cb.afterRequest(generation, cb.isSuccessful(err))"). Name reads the immutable configured name gobreaker.go:202 ("return cb.name").
